# agentglass

> Every AI coding agent on your machine, on one screen. agentglass attaches to the tmux sessions and repositories already open on a developer's machine — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode — and shows every tool call, what each costs, who is waiting on a human, and holds anything dangerous until somebody says go. Local by default: a Bun + SQLite server on loopback, a desktop app (Linux, macOS, Windows) and an Android companion. Open source, MIT.

It does not launch or replace agents. It observes them through their own hook and transcript streams, gates the tool calls a person chose to gate, and gives the agents a browser of their own — one already signed in to what the person is signed in to — driven from a CLI and an MCP server.

- [Configuration and API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SirAllap/agentglass/main/docs/CONFIG.md): every environment variable the code reads, the whole HTTP API, the architecture
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SirAllap/agentglass/main/SECURITY.md): the trust model, what each surface can reach, retention, how to report a vulnerability
- [Extending](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SirAllap/agentglass/main/docs/EXTENDING.md): driving agentglass from your own harness, and writing a plugin
- [Plugins](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SirAllap/agentglass/main/docs/PLUGINS.md): what a plugin is, what it may ask for, how to publish one
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SirAllap/agentglass/main/CHANGELOG.md): what each release changed

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SirAllap/agentglass/main/AGENTS.md): the short version for an agent — using the built-in browser from a session, and working in this repository
